slot_note: author-requested re-root (2026-11-11): a much stronger stump than architecture 1, at least three major analytical failure points, new areas, not a template of task6
niche: a Philippine electric cooperative's referral rule for the overhead protection zones whose lightning protection (arrester ground leads, line arresters, pin insulators) has failed, built from recloser event logs on their own clocks and a lightning location extract, ahead of the 2027 dry-season refit
analyst_test: A careful run that cleans every export, reads lightning faults off the reclosers' logged times with a fixed window, counts only the events the controllers' memories kept, fits the sound-protection rate on every zone-season and refers on a Poisson or pooled threshold files a referral set that drops the radio-less zones and the failures the contaminated baseline absorbs, adds sound zones whose spread a Poisson null cannot carry, and misstates the alert load, the inspection check and the avoided faults.
domain_test: The field's own lightning performance analysis decides it: faults attributed to lightning by coincidence with located strokes on each protective device's own clock, a zone's flashover rate per nearby stroke against what its construction, shielding and arrester cover give when sound, and the spread of sound zones around that expectation; with a hospital's nouns the strokes, reclosers, clocks, arresters and flashovers have no meaning.
layer1: lightning location times in UTC against controller times in Philippine local time
cloud pulses and small positive discharges in the stroke extract
each fault logged as several trips and recloses
upstream breakers tripping on downstream faults
controller memories re-read at each visit so events repeat across downloads
outage cause codes assigned by dispatchers
transformer replacements recorded days after the burnout
register line lengths summed by setting and construction
stakeholder_role: the co-op's technical services manager, who takes the 2027 lightning protection refit to the management committee

spine.file: recloser and breaker event exports with the lightning stroke extract
spine.entity: one event a protective device recorded
spine.source: synthetic (a fictional Philippine electric cooperative's SCADA historian export and controller memory downloads, December 2021 to October 2026, with a lightning location extract; seeded world in task13/generator)

world.geography: Philippines (Central Luzon: a fictional electric cooperative's franchise across rice plains, tree-lined roads, towns and the western foothills)
world.org_type: a member-owned electric cooperative running 13.2 kV overhead lines from twelve substations

driver: Events counted per unit are recorded by instruments that keep their own drifting time and only their last few hundred records, read on an observer's schedule, so the units with the most events lose the most and line up the worst with the independent record that classifies them; the expected count each unit should have is learned only from unit-periods that a later physical check confirmed sound, and the alarm threshold carries the spread those confirmed units show beyond chance.
driver_concrete: Each zone's lightning faults are its reclosers' trips matched to located strokes on each controller's own clock (the radio-less controllers drift minutes between site visits and keep only their last 64 or 100 events, so a failing zone's busiest months are overwritten); the faults a zone would have with sound protection come from seasons the next cyclic inspection found sound, and the referral threshold carries the scatter of those confirmed-sound zones at no more than one sound zone referred a season.
stump: A careful run that reads lightning faults off every recloser's logged times with a fixed window, counts only the events the radio-less controllers' memories kept, fits the sound-protection rate on every zone-season and refers on a Poisson threshold refers sound zones whose spread the Poisson null cannot carry and misses the radio-less zones and the failures the contaminated baseline absorbs, so its referral set, alert load, inspection check and avoided faults are all off.
results: R1 lightning faults per season reconstructed on every protective device's own clock; R2 the radio-less zones' 2026 lightning faults with what their memories lost and their unread months filled; R3 the 2026 season with every zone's protection sound and the faults failed protection caused; R4 the zones the rule refers now; R5 its false referrals a season and its referrals after each season since 2022; R6 its referrals checked against the following cyclic inspections; R7 the likely failure at each referred zone; R8 the lightning faults the refit avoids in an average season
one_fact_test: the reclosers with no radio link keep their own drifting clocks: rescues R1 and part of R2 (2 of 8)

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is what restoring a unit's condition removes from its next-period event count, which is only the part of its event rate that has grown since the condition was last restored, per unit of an exposure that drives every event; the latest counts mix that growth with each unit's own base and with an exposure that moved in opposite directions across areas, so the units that look worst were selected on a high-exposure year or on a high base the restoration cannot touch, and the units with the most to gain look ordinary.
lineage.architecture: v1 (Kotuku Networks, the 2027 vegetation catch-up on six 11 kV feeders, one Poisson fit of tree interruptions on station gust load with growth since trim)
lineage.fate: spent 2026-11-11 before upload: cut under the retired single-deep-step design (READY 2026-11-09, never run on the platform); re-rooted at the author's word for a stronger chain with at least three independent analytical failure points. Its record: the storm-track swing between stations was thin (one plot of gust hours by station shows it), the plantation feeders' dense corridor sat only in the deciding units with one filter as the fix (a send-back), and every graded figure came out of one Poisson fit (one thing under another name).

differentiation.task13: v2 is a new world (a Philippine cooperative's lightning protection, not a New Zealand lines company's vegetation), a new answer shape (a monitoring rule with its alert load, not a ranked list) and a chain of eight results; nothing of v1's gust-load fit or trim-growth split survives
differentiation.mark196: mark196 recovers how many events a partly captured record misses from the overlap of two capture channels; here the events are recovered from one device's own record (a sequence gap and an unread tail) and its drifting clock against a lightning extract, and the decisive call is a referral threshold carried on the spread of inspection-confirmed sound units
differentiation.task6: task6 weights spans by a sampling share set where each trace starts and dates incident causes by onset; here no sample is drawn: events are aligned to an independent record across drifting device clocks, an overwritten memory is filled, and units are referred against a baseline confirmed by physical inspection
